records.title: Adapting Large Language Models by Integrating Collaborative Semantics for Recommendation
records.reason: The paper’s contribution is collaborative-semantic adaptation and item generation for recommendation. Its “inference” sections are task-prompt/user-preference inference, not runtime optimization.

records.title: Neural Machine Translation: A Review
records.reason: Its abstract describes a review of NMT model families and trends and does not propose or evaluate an LLM inference technique.

records.title: HAWQ-V2: Hessian Aware trace-Weighted Quantization of Neural Networks
records.reason: Borderline because mixed-precision quantization is a direct potential inference-memory/latency technique, but no LLM/transformer evaluation in this source demonstrates transfer or serving benefit.

records.title: The Lottery Ticket Hypothesis for Pre-trained BERT Networks
records.reason: Borderline: the source concerns BERT pruning/sparsity, but says hardware speedup for training/inference remains future work. Require a sparse runtime benchmark with end-task quality before treating it as an inference optimization.
